module: Routes of the guided first drive (Vue): introduction, onboarding, arrival, completion, recovery, learning areas. Back is locked (`firstDriveLockedHandler`) except onboarding (previousRouteBackHandler). The onMount/onEnter/onLeave hooks call gameplay_discover_firstDrive_experience.
notes: Route configuration module: it exports no function. routeManager reads it (via the ui_router_routes_<name> extension) when routes.lua includes it with `{ include = "<name>" }`.
The keys of `Children` form the segments of the dotted name: "<module>.<child>". `children` (lowercase) in a node designates its sub-routes; `include` mounts another module there.
`ui` is inherited by child routes (uiTypes, uiTypesFilter, infoBar, topBar, uiApps, uiNav, triggerPause): a child redefines it only for what changes.

Root.desc: {screenId = "firstDrive", onMount = "gameplay_discover_firstDrive_experience.onFirstDriveRouteMount", back = handler firstDriveLockedHandler, scopeTree first-drive-intro, ui = Vue, bars hidden, uiApps hidden, triggerPause = false}

Children.desc: onboarding (infoBar visible), arrival, completion (dedicated onMount, locked back), recovery (backTarget play, onLeave onFirstDriveRecoveryRouteLeave), learning (backTarget pause, dedicated onEnter/onLeave, triggerPause = true, scope first-drive-learning-areas).

ModuleName.desc: Name of the routes module (first segment of the dotted name).
